 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. India A will begin their campaign at the Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 with a Group B clash against Nepal at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium in Doha on Friday, November 20.
Led by Tilak Varma, the Indian side will be eager to make a winning start to the tournament, which features eight teams competing in the 50-over format. India A have assembled a strong squad featuring several established international names, including Abhishek Sharma, Rinku Singh, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Harshit Rana.
The spotlight, however, will be firmly on 15-year-old Vaibhav, who returns to Doha after enjoying a sensational outing at the same venue last year. His explosive batting could prove to be a major attraction as India look to begin their campaign on a positive note.
 Tilak Varma leads strong India A squad 
 Tilak Varma (C), Rajat Patidar, Abhishek Sharma, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, Prabhsimran Singh, Rinku Singh, Kumar Kushagra, Suryansh Shedge, Shahbaz Ahmed, Vipraj Nigam, Harsh Dubey, Tanush Kotian, Harshit Rana, Prince Yadav, Arshad Khan.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Nepal pose challenge under Sandeep Lamichhane 
 Nepal, meanwhile, will be led by experienced leg-spinner Sandeep Lamichhane and will look to challenge the Indian side with a combination of experienced international players and emerging talent. Nepal will be eager to make an impression against a formidable India A side and strengthen their chances of progressing to the knockout stages.
With Lamichhane leading the spin attack and experienced campaigners providing balance, Nepal will hope to make the contest competitive.
 India A vs Nepal: Match details, live streaming 
 The fourth match of the Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 will be played on Friday at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium in Doha, Qatar.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Match: India A vs Nepal, Match 4, Group B
 Date: Friday, November 20, 2026
 Time: 3:30 PM IST
 Venue: West End Park International Cricket Stadium, Doha
 Live streaming: Sony LIV
 TV telecast: Sony Sports Network
 Tournament format and schedule 
 The eight participating teams have been divided into two groups of four. India A are placed in Group B alongside Pakistan Shaheens, Nepal and the UAE. The top two teams from each group will qualify for the semi-finals, scheduled for November 26 and 27, while the final will take place on November 29.
After their opening fixture against Nepal, India A will face Pakistan Shaheens on November 22 before taking on the UAE on November 24.
